rules.human_readable_meaning: A purchase order strictly above USD 50,000 requires two distinct valid PURCHASE approvals, including at least one DIRECTOR approval.
rules.applicability: Eligible ISSUED or CLOSED purchase orders dated on or after 2026-01-01 with total amount strictly greater than USD 50,000.

parameters.valid_approval: PURCHASE, APPROVED, on or before order date, distinct approver

rules.canonical_source_phrase: strictly greater than USD 50,000 requires two distinct valid PURCHASE approvals, including at least one valid approval by a DIRECTOR

rules.human_readable_meaning: IT Services and Professional Services purchase orders require a valid contract at issuance or a documented, DIRECTOR-approved contract exception recorded no later than issuance.
rules.applicability: Eligible ISSUED or CLOSED purchase orders dated on or after 2026-01-01 in IT Services or Professional Services.

parameters.valid_contract: resolved, supplier and category match, covers order date, and is not terminated on or before order date
parameters.valid_exception: CONTRACT_EXCEPTION, APPROVED, DIRECTOR, on or before order date

rules.canonical_source_phrase: a valid contract at issuance is required unless a documented contract exception was approved by a DIRECTOR no later than issuance
